text:
maria: FYI — onboarding sample-app just routed traffic into our org key instead of the intended project key after a credential rotation. Repro steps in the logs below.

maria: repro summary: start app with RW_API_KEY_PROJECT set, run `make start`, rotate project key via console, new requests billed to org key.

maria: suspected cause: ambiguous env var precedence between REDWOOD_API_KEY and RW_API_KEY_PROJECT. CLI warns but SDK silently uses REDWOOD_API_KEY if present.

devon: I reproduced locally. SDK v1.4 changed order when loading envs during init. It checks REDWOOD_API_KEY first (legacy), then per-scope keys. logs: `auth: selected key=REDWOOD_API_KEY (org)` then `request: Authorization: Bearer <org-key>`.

devon: minimal repro snippet:
```
# env
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"org-xxxx\"
export RW_API_KEY_PROJECT=\"proj-aaaa\"
node sampleapp.js
# result: headers show org-xxxx
```

sam: separate but related: long-lived streaming clients (websocket / SSE) don't handle rotation well. When token rotates we get 401 mid-stream and the SDK currently drops the connection without attempting a refresh+retry. This kills real-time features.

sam: proposed behavior: on 401 mid-stream call a registered tokenProvider.refresh() (if present), swap auth header and retry the failed frame/heartbeat once. If still 401 -> surface event to app.

tara: +1. Also we should standardize env naming to make precedence obvious. Suggestion: prefer most-specific first: RW_API_KEY_PROJECT, RW_API_KEY_SERVICE, RW_API_KEY_ORG, then fallback to REDWOOD_API_KEY. Add a single-file diag at startup that logs which env var and which key was chosen (masked).

devon: agree on diag. Also add a one-time warning log if both REDWOOD_API_KEY and RW_API_KEY_PROJECT are defined because that's almost always user-error. CLI already warns during `rw init` but libs should be defensive.

maria: for rotation UX, we need unit + e2e tests:
- unit: env precedence permutations
- e2e: start stream, rotate key, ensure SDK refreshes and continues (or emits clear event)

infra-bot: deploy: sampleapp/dogfood v2.3.1 -> staging finished :white_check_mark:

tara: I'll file a PR to revert the precedence change and add opt-in behavior for legacy key. Plan:
1) change loader to prefer specific RW_API_KEY_* vars
2) add RW_ENABLE_TOKEN_REFRESH=true default
3) expose a TokenRefreshHandler in SDK to allow apps to hook into rotation events
4) add a startup diagnostic log and a single warning if ambiguous keys found

devon: tiny UX question: do we want env var names with scope suffix (_PROJECT/_ORG) or use prefixes (PROJECT_API_KEY)? I prefer suffix to keep `RW_API_KEY_` as a clear namespace.

tara: suffix is fine. We'll also document a migration path and a compatibility flag `RW_LEGACY_KEY_COMPAT=true` that keeps the old behavior for a release cycle.

maria: action items: @tara open PR + link issue; @devon add e2e for streaming rotation; @sam write test that simulates 401 mid-stream and asserts single refresh attempt; @maria update onboarding docs to recommend clearing REDWOOD_API_KEY when using project keys.

deploy-bot: created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1427 \"SDK: env precedence + streaming token-refresh on rotation\"

maria: thanks — let's keep the change small and opt-in for now, but ship the warning ASAP so new onboards don't silently mis-bill. :pray:

devon: will follow up with PR ref and tests later today.

sam: I'll prototype TokenRefreshHandler and share a patch to the sampleapp so customers can model a graceful reconnect.

tara: assigning myself to the issue and will add the diag + docs bits.

maria: excellent. closing thread for now, will reopen if we see other regressions.
